notes:
Account overview: enterprise financial services firm with ~2k global support agents; currently piloting agent-assist in NA (Zendesk + in-house CRM). Expanding to full contact-center automation across EU and APAC teams — big upsell opportunity for Dedicated + Private deployment.

Summary of needs / constraints:
- Workloads: real-time agent assist (suggested replies, next-best actions), post-call ticket summarization, tool-calling to open/annotate tickets, automatic case routing, QA sampling.
- Traffic: baseline 400 concurrent agent sessions; expected peak 1,200 concurrent during end-of-month and product incidents. Need graceful degradation under spike.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 response for suggestion generation <= 250-350ms (strict for agent UX); throughput target ~1.5-2k requests/sec during spikes.
- Quality: summarization accuracy target >= 85% on internal QA rubric; handle-time reduction target 15-20%.
- Model preferences: preference for open LLMs with quantized variants; allow fallback to cheaper hosted models for burst capacity. Function/tool calling required for ticket creation and CRM writes.
- Compliance: must keep EU agent transcripts in-region; PCI scope concerns for payment beta flows — may require on-prem for specific subsystems. SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS integration for keys, audit logs retained 7+ years for compliance.
